feedback: The current robot design has significant issues with line loss, as evidenced by the telemetry showing a maximum error of 0.061435 and control effort of 1.026406. The robot stalled during trials, indicating that the adjustments made to the sensor positions and wheel track did not sufficiently improve stability. I recommend increasing the wheel track to 0.18 for better stability and adjusting the sensor positions to be more evenly distributed across the body width. Additionally, consider reducing the control effort by fine-tuning the PID parameters, particularly lowering the kp value to 0.8 to reduce overshooting.
